sentences.en: I like Japanese rice pillows; they are good for my neck.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢日本米制枕头；它们对我的脖子有好处。

sentences.en: I had a lot of pillow fights during my school trip.
sentences.zh: 在学校旅行期间，我和朋友们玩了很多枕头大战。

sentences.en: An ideal pillow is available from a mail-order house.
sentences.zh: 一家邮购公司提供了一个理想的枕头。
